county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the gatherings during the investigation, it was determined concrete evidence exists to support that the school have not followed the instructions on the sanitizing solution.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §744.805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The records for the site director and additional staff person were not available for review at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Dates of Test & Battery Installation, Director/Designee Name Who Tested & Installed (26 TAC §744.3757(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The date of each monthly test for the carbon monoxide for the month of January 2026, and February 2026.

top_violation_types.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Sole caregiver and person in charge did not have access to records to be reviewed for approximately one hour of inspection.     This was corrected when operation director arrived one hour after children were in care.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.
